This opinion must explain why that method, applied to the Coal Act's own accounting and correction structure, preserves authority without turning the deadline optional. His full frozen commitment also preserves Sigmon's substantive categories and the agency's unfinished factual task. Souter is the strongest pool alternative for the contextual synthesis, with the same count; Kennedy's demonstrated treatment of the precise timing distinction gives him the fit advantage here. Stone's approved separation of deadline, eligibility and initial decisionmaker is carried without alteration, but his own authorship adds no concrete advantage over Kennedy.
